citations.claim: body at rest at start before controller acts
after one step body accelerated to speed 8.67 consistent with excessive ~260N force, exceeding declared 200N fmax

explanation: Controller velocity-error law commands force above fmax without clamping. From (10,6) toward (19,11) with kp=100, vcmd=20, the engine reports controller_force 260 at step 1, exceeding fmax 200, producing excessive acceleration (speed 8.67 in one 1/30s step).
vision_note: The strip shows a single red circular body near the centre of the arena at step 0 with a green waypoint cross in the top-right corner. At step 1 the body remains in essentially the same central position with no visible wall, escape, or large jump.
